description: This file defines the `OpenClawActivityAttributes` struct and associated nested `ContentState` struct, which are used for managing and representing the state of a Live Activity in an iOS app utilizing ActivityKit. It includes preview instances and predefined states for development purposes.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Provides a static preview instance of `OpenClawActivityAttributes` for development purposes.

methods.name: connecting
methods.description: Static instance of `ContentState` representing the 'Connecting...' state.

methods.name: idle
methods.description: Static instance of `ContentState` representing the 'Idle' state.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Static instance of `ContentState` representing the 'Disconnected' state.
